limitations: Data-only validator foundation, not yet wired to HTTP, filesystem import, registry, trust UI or runtime discovery
ASCII skill names currently supported; broader Unicode names and native loader interoperability remain to verify
128 files, 1MiB per file, 4MiB package and 16KiB frontmatter are Rocky bounded import limits; YAML aliases/custom tags rejected
Hash validation is not authorization, script sandboxing, secret review or immutable persistence
No new browser/Ubuntu/live evidence; global AT unchanged
assertions: Standard YAML name/description metadata, folded description, license and metadata map
Binary assets preserved; sorted path/size/SHA256 manifest produces deterministic package hash
Traversal, absolute paths, NTFS streams, device names, case collisions and file/directory conflicts rejected
Invalid UTF8, duplicate YAML keys, unknown tags, aliases, malformed base64 and size limits rejected
allowed-tools retained as untrusted metadata without constructing grants
